C-BROWSER-DEVTOOLS-DIAGNOSTICS-20260903.IntentSummary:
Deliver the bounded M1.3 browser-service devtools diagnostics slice by adding a replaceable, engine-neutral diagnostics capability above the browser provider and proving it against the real CEF path.
The plan keeps diagnostics above the kernel, rejects raw CDP passthrough and remote debugging server exposure as the primary contract, bounds all diagnostic buffers and field lengths, enforces strict BrowserContextId and PageId isolation, tags records with DocumentRevision, omits sensitive cookie/auth/body payloads by default, and proves both a deterministic reference S3D slice and a real Windows CEF hosted S3D slice.
Admission is codex_led on the isolated branch codex/browser-devtools-diagnostics-spec-20260903, based on the approved spec. Predecessor change C-BROWSER-REQUEST-POLICY-INTERCEPTION-SCOPE-CORRECTION-20260902 has been applied and archived, satisfying the lifecycle gate.

T-001.Title: Draft and freeze the browser devtools diagnostics architecture decision record (ADR)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Document the engine-neutral diagnostic boundary: CEF/provider extracts facts, maps to normalized DTOs, forwards to bounded worldline-browser-devtools service, which serves authorized consumers.
Explicitly record rejection of raw Chrome DevTools frontend, CDP passthrough, and ambient remote debugging server.
Specify authority separation: AUTH_DEVTOOLS_OBSERVE (read console/network/runtime diagnostics), AUTH_DEVTOOLS_CONTROL (clear buffers), AUTH_DEVTOOLS_NATIVE (optional native inspector escape hatch).
Specify privacy and sensitivity boundaries: cookies, authorization headers, request/response bodies, client certs are excluded from default DTOs. Console text and full URLs are bounded and scoped.
Specify bounded retention: per-page ring buffers, field size limits, drop/truncation metadata counters, DocumentRevision tagging, lifecycle cleanup, and failure isolation.

T-002.Title: Define experimental browser.devtools/0.1 contract and normalized diagnostic DTOs

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Add crates/worldline-browser-services-contract/src/devtools.rs declaring the experimental browser.devtools/0.1 service contract.

Define normalized DTOs: ConsoleDiagnosticRecord (level, message, source, line, DocumentRevision, timestamp), NetworkDiagnosticRecord (method, resource_type, url, status, http_status, mime_type, bytes, duration, DocumentRevision), PageRuntimeDiagnosticSnapshot (context_id, page_id, revision, url, title, loading_state), DiagnosticQuery, DiagnosticQueryResult, DiagnosticBufferStats.
Declare authority constants AUTH_DEVTOOLS_OBSERVE, AUTH_DEVTOOLS_CONTROL, AUTH_DEVTOOLS_NATIVE disjoint from ordinary page observation authority.
Validate serialization and field length truncation/validation in unit tests.

T-003.Title: Implement worldline-browser-devtools service plugin with bounded ring buffers

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Create crates/worldline-browser-devtools containing the diagnostics service plugin.
Implement per-(BrowserContextId, PageId) bounded ring buffers with finite entry and byte bounds, enforcing drop-oldest policy and recording dropped_count and truncated_count in buffer stats.
Implement query operations requiring AUTH_DEVTOOLS_OBSERVE with strict Context/Page isolation and clear operations requiring AUTH_DEVTOOLS_CONTROL.
Implement lifecycle cleanup when a Page or BrowserContext is closed or destroyed.
Ensure ephemeral behavior: diagnostics reset on service restart without stale handles surviving across runtimes.

T-004.Title: Wire real CEF console and network callbacks to normalized provider diagnostic flow

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Wire CefDisplayHandler::on_console_message in worldline-browser-cef to capture log/info, warn, error with source and line.

Wire CefResourceRequestHandler (on_before_resource_load, on_resource_response, on_resource_load_complete) and CefLoadHandler (on_load_error) to capture resource lifecycle facts (method, type, url, status, http_status, bytes) without body or sensitive header exposure.
Bridge facts across the native provider process boundary using bounded, non-blocking notification messages.
If provider-native DevTools is exposed as an escape hatch, gate behind AUTH_DEVTOOLS_NATIVE and fail explicitly when unsupported without returning raw CEF pointers.

T-005.Title: Implement deterministic S3D proving slice and reference acceptance tests

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Create crates/worldline-reference/src/s3d.rs and tests/s3d_acceptance.rs with a deterministic loopback fixture emitting known console log/warn/error, successful resource, and 404 resource.
Prove console capture (log, warn, error) and network capture (200 OK, 404 Not Found) through the normalized diagnostics service.
Prove BrowserContextId and PageId isolation: Context A cannot observe Context B's diagnostics.
Prove flood overflow: emitting 1000 console records maintains finite memory, records dropped entries, and preserves page responsiveness.
Prove DocumentRevision isolation: navigation tags new entries and old entries are not presented as current document facts.
Prove failure isolation: crashing or unloading worldline-browser-devtools does not disrupt browsing, tabs, history, cookies, or request policy.

T-006.Title: Implement hosted Windows real-CEF S3D acceptance tests

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Create crates/worldline-reference/tests/s3d_real_acceptance.rs running the S3D loopback page against the real pinned CEF provider process.
Prove that real CEF callbacks generate normalized console and network diagnostic records observable through the Worldline service contract.
Record provider and runtime identity in the test report and fail closed if ReferenceBrowserBackend is substituted.
Gate execution on Windows and require staged CEF environment variables.

T-007.Title: Add architecture guards and BrowserDevTools CI suite

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Extend scripts/ci/Test-WorldlineArchitecture.ps1 to verify worldline-kernel contains no devtools/CDP/CEF domain types, no raw CDP passthrough exists, and browser-devtools is not a dependency of other browser services.
Add BrowserDevTools CI suite to scripts/ci/Invoke-WorldlineCi.ps1 covering contracts, bounds, isolation, S3D reference, and hosted Windows real-CEF tests.

T-008.Title: Execute full regression gates and produce completion packet

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Run formatting, workspace check, clippy (-D warnings), workspace tests, architecture guards, and all CI suites.
Generate completion packet distinguishing scaffolded, wired, and verified claims with named runs.
Do not mutate .grace/graph or .grace/verification until explicit apply confirmation is received from the user.
